```python
import json, hashlib
from math import gcd

def band_ref(items, epsilon):
    # items: list of (value, weight)
    # brute force over all (lo,hi) pairs of observed values
    values = sorted(set(v for v,_ in items))
    best = None
    for i,lo in enumerate(values):
        for hi in values[i:]:
            if 1000000*(hi-lo) <= epsilon*hi:
                w = sum(wt for v,wt in items if lo <= v <= hi)
                cand = (-w, lo, hi)
                if best is None or cand < best:
                    best = cand
    if best is None: return None
    w, lo, hi = -best[0], best[1], best[2]
    s = sum(v*wt for v,wt in items if lo <= v <= hi)
    return s//w, w
```
This brute force is the literal spec. Note the tie-break: maximize w, minimize lo, minimize hi → key = (-w, lo, hi) minimized ✓.
